description: Painted works from antiquity rarely survive due to their delicate materials. The exception is funerary portraits painted in encaustic, or pigmented wax, like this example produced in Roman-ruled Egypt. Here, the subject’s large, heavy lidded eyes, narrow chin, and full lips express his individuality, while his thick, curly hair and neatly trimmed beard indicate the adoption of contemporary Roman fashions.
title: Portrait of a Man Wearing an Ivy Wreath
